tests: Once decided: internal/database/store_test.go round-trip test asserting sub-second Duration survives a write/read cycle.

internal/server/handlers/abs/mapper_test.go (or the existing ABS conformance harness) asserting DurationSec/startOffset now match the oracle within float precision, not the current bounded-truncation allowance.
acceptance: N/A until design decision is made.
